usage: 一杯 is used to indicate the quantity of a drink or liquid that fits into one cup.
It can be used with different types of beverages like tea, coffee, or juice.
When you say 一杯, it implies one serving as measured by a cup, not necessarily a fixed volume measure.
You can use 一杯 when ordering drinks or describing how much liquid is needed in cooking.
一杯 by itself is usually followed by the type of drink or content to specify what is being measured.
